claims.text: Oral dofetilide or IV ibutilide: useful for acute drug cardioversion of AFL.
claims.quote: Oral dofetilide or intravenous ibutilide is useful for acute pharmacological cardioversion in patients with atrial flutter.

claims.quote: The following drugs can be useful to maintain sinus rhythm in patients with symptomatic, recurrent atrial flutter

a. Amiodarone
b. Dofetilide
c. Sotalol
